title_sq: Shiten dy dyqane buze rruge ne Bulevardin Zogu i Pare (ID 4171607)
description_sq:
Ne Bulevardin Zogu i Pare, shitet dyqane buze rruge, shitet dyqan i pozicionuar buze rruges kryesore, siperfaqe 60 m², kati perdhe i ngritur me 3 shkalle, ndertim ekzistues, kubature e rregullt, fasade xhami, mundesi reklamim, i rikonstruktuar totalisht.
Prona disponon dukumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
Aktualisht dyqani eshte i ndare ne dy dyqane te dyja te dhena me qera.
Mundesi shume e mire investimi ndodhur ne nje nder zonat me te preferuara ne Tirane, shume prane qendres.
Mund te shiten dhe te ndare: siperfaqe 33 m² me cmim 330 000 euro
siperfaqe 27 m² me cmim 300 000 euro.
Se bashku shiten 630 000 euro.
title_en: Two roadside shops for sale on Zogu i Pare Boulevard (ID 4171607)
description_en: On the Zogu i Pare Boulevard, street side shops for sale, shop positioned on the side of the main street, surface 60 m², ground floor raised with 3 stairs, existing building, regular volume, glass facade, possibility of advertising, totally reconstructed. The property has regular mortgage documentation. Currently, the store is divided into two stores, both rented. Very good investment opportunity located in one of the most preferred areas in Tirana, very close to the center. Can be sold and divided: 33 m² area at a price of 330,000 euros, 27 m² area at a price of 300,000 euros. Together they are sold for 630,000 euros.
